what: Approve latency on the deployed API after PR #90 (copy call submitted first under a 3 s budget; plays that already carry copy skip it). Six wall-clock samples: four Tea (the Darjeeling Tea hero play, a recorded Gemini run, gap_tea_ds04) and two chips (a recorded play).
measured_at: about 09:55 IST, after the owner merged #90 (main 891f806)

method.tool: curl, one POST per sample; the number is the wall time of that request
method.instance: warm: none of the six was a first call after idle; the first call after idle takes longer (the pre-#90 cold-ish call in approve_timing_2026-10-12.json was 10.1 s)
method.visitor: a fresh X-Taal-Visitor value for every call, so each approve starts from a new visitor store

summary.published_range: about 3 to 7 s (measured 12 Oct after #90; first call after idle takes longer)

caveat: Six samples from one morning, not a percentile estimate. The range is what was measured, not a service-level target. Before #90 the same recorded plays took 7 to 15 s (see approve_timing_2026-10-12.json, kept as history).
history: approve_timing_2026-10-12.json holds the pre-#90 samples and stays unchanged
